title: Policy-driven token minting and emergency revoke playbook
creator: Diego Morales
description: Problem: Our current token provisioning is ad hoc: service owners manually create long-lived service tokens, naming is inconsistent, and emergency revocation paths are slow. This increases blast radius and complicates audits. Goal: Deliver a policy-driven token minting system plus an operational playbook for emergency revokes that integrates with RBAC v2 and audit logging. Deliverables: 1) Token minting API with policy enforcement (per-scope TTLs, allowed scopes, naming templates). 2) Token metadata ledger and searchable audit view (immutable append-only events). 3) Emergency revoke workflow (single-click revoke, cascade invalidation, rotation automation) with documented runbook. 4) Migration path for existing tokens including soft-expiry and adoption metrics. Non-goals: This ticket does not include UI changes to Console; it focuses on backend APIs, audit plumbing, and the runbook. Acceptance criteria: - New minting API enforces configured policies for at least two pilot teams. - All minted tokens are recorded in ledger with created_by, policy_id, scopes, expiry, and last_used. - Emergency revoke endpoint invalidates tokens across runtime planes within SLO (target 30s) and emits an audit event. - A documented runbook is published in Confluence, linked in this ticket. - Migration script and audit report for at least 80% of existing tokens completed for pilot orgs. Out-of-scope: full Console integration and RBAC UI. Rollout plan: 1) Implement policy engine and minting API behind feature flag. 2) Integrate ledger and audit events (WAL-backed append-only). 3) Pilot with infra and payments teams for 3 weeks. 4) Iterate on policy templates and add default naming conventions. 5) Release feature flag and run migration with telemetry monitoring. Monitoring & KPIs: - Token issuance by policy (count) per week. - Time to revoke (P90) for emergency revoke. - Fraction of tokens with compliant naming. - Number of unauthorized mint attempts blocked. Risks & mitigations: - Risk: revocation race causing in-flight requests to succeed. Mitigation: introduce short TTL on cached token validations and a cascade invalidation mechanism for KV caches. - Risk: migration breaks long-lived jobs. Mitigation: soft-expiry and grace rollover tokens issued automatically after owner approval. Links: - Design doc: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SI/pages/Policy+driven+token+minting - GH RFC: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rfcs/pull/214 - Pilot dashboard (grafana): https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/tokens/pilot-token-health - Incident learning: https://drive.redwood.com/incident/token-2025-11-postmortem

2026-02-18 Linh Nguyen: Reviewed RFC - suggested adding immutable ledger and explicit policy IDs to improve auditability. Also requested metrics for revoke SLO.
2026-02-25 Asha Patel: Implemented prototype mint endpoint and local policy evaluator. Observed edge case where wildcard scopes allowed escalation; added disallow-list in policy evaluator.

2026-03-02 Marta Ivanova (Security): Security review - approved with 2 conditions: (1) emergency revoke must emit a signed audit event; (2) KMS usage must be enforced for token sealing. See review notes: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-102
2026-03-05 Diego Morales: Pushed PR for ledger schema and background reaper: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/5341 (tests failing on WAL replay - investigating).

2026-03-09 Asha Patel: Demoed pilot to infra team. Metrics baseline collected: avg time to revoke (non-cascade) 280s; target needs to be <=30s. Identified cache invalidation path as primary blocker. Added sub-task to invalidate runtime KV caches via publish/subscribe channel.

2026-03-11 Blake Carter (SRE): Proposed fallback plan: on revoke, mark token as revoked in ledger and publish invalidate message; runtime will check ledger on cache miss for 2 minutes to avoid blocking hot paths. Trade-off: slightly higher latency on first miss but improved revoke correctness.

2026-03-12 Asha Patel: Updated runbook draft with emergency run steps and communication play (pager duty, templates), link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SI/pages/Emergency+Token+Revoke+Playbook
